name: waffle-commons
description: The waffle-commons repository's own Claude Code plugins: the waffle-cockpit mod and a pinned, curated copy of Matt Pocock's engineering skills.

plugins.name: waffle-cockpit
plugins.description: Three status lines under the prompt, /dod in a pane with no model turn, and a Bash guard for host-side PHP, submodule --remote syncs and release-tag pushes.

plugins.name: mattpocock-skills
plugins.description: Matt Pocock's engineering skills (grilling, TDD, diagnosing bugs, writing for agents, spec and tickets…), vendored at a pinned commit and curated for this repository.
